card.title: IPad Air 5
symptoms: Apple logo flashing on and off

claims.statement: On iPad Air 5 a flashing Apple logo is fixed by disconnecting (then replacing) the power button flex.
iPad Air 5 model numbers: A2588 Wi-Fi only; A2589 and A2591 Wi-Fi + Cellular.

procedure: Disconnect the power button flex and retest boot.
card.caveats: Connector diode readings on the source page are images only. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
